description.en: An eight-legged spider spins a web around an album cover and carries it between the queue and player, with real album artwork and working local controls.
description.zh: 八足蜘蛛结网牵引专辑封面，在队列与播放区之间连续搬运，搭配真实专辑图片和可操作的本地播放控件。

keywords: 蜘蛛 蛛丝 结网 专辑 封面 音乐 播放器 队列 切歌 牵引 spider web music player album cover queue track switcher Divan Raj

discovery.caveat: 使用真实封面与本地播放计时；接入真实音源时替换媒体数据并核对封面权限。

source.implementation: Independent DOM, inline SVG and GSAP reconstruction. Eight verified third-party album covers with copyright and source records are used as requested; no AI-generated cover art is used.
source.license: Original motion design/source license not supplied or independently verified. Reference footage remains internal. Album covers retain their respective owners' rights and Apple Music source records; no free artwork redistribution license is claimed. No song audio, commercial font or original author code is included.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Choose a queue row, or use previous and next to watch the spider fetch and return covers. Search, pause, seek, like and add tracks locally; the demo does not stream audio.
instructions.zh: 点击队列，或用上一首、下一首观察蜘蛛牵引和归还封面。支持本地搜索、暂停、进度调整、喜欢与添加歌曲；演示不播放音源。
